_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id}, playing {num_rounds} rounds of Iterated Ultimatum Game.
You have ${pool} to split this round between yourself and Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Make an offer: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - If accepted → You get $(pool - X), other player gets $X
  - If rejected → Both get $0
  - Example: [Offer: $3]  or  'I think this is fair. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Decide on the offer with either [Accept] or [Reject]
  - Example: 'That seems reasonable. [Accept]'
            'Too unfair. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Mzungu {round_number} utaanza! ---
Mwana {proposer_id} nde muntu asalaka, Mwana {responder_id} nde muntu akubali.
round.accepted: Mwana {responder_id} akubali! Mzungu {round_number} mafuta: Mwana {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mwana {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Mafuta mapya: Mwana 0: ${total_0}, Mwana 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mwana luyitu {responder_id} wasambula lilongi! Milongi {round_number} wakala: Boke bakala +$0. Wensi wensi: Mwana luyitu 0: ${total_0}, Mwana luyitu 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Muntu yina ke pesa mukanda ya kubaka mbongo fwete sadila formilere yai [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Ntalu ya bo me pesa fwete vanda ntalu mosi yina kele mbote.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Ata kima mosi ve ya bo me pesa beto bubu yai.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder must either [Accept] or [Reject] the offer.

outcome.win: Mwanabandi {winner} abandaki na ${winner_total} kwa jumla, kumpemba Mwanabandi {loser} na ${loser_total} kwandi.
outcome.draw: Bo yonso zole me manisa na mbongo ${total}.
